purpose: Freeze Campaign265's complete source-verification, candidate construction, coverage-first and ordered-numeric-uniqueness procedure before the first accepted source snapshot or any candidate/comparator value is opened.

accepted_source_snapshot.plan_value_boundary: The plan may read JSON metadata and hash immutable Parquet bytes, but may not decode any Parquet row or import/create a provider client.
accepted_source_snapshot.audit_open_condition: The repository acceptance manifest, internal manifest, exact cb_basic checkpoint, all 1699 exact-date cb_daily checkpoints, sidecars, byte hashes, schemas, request ordinals, request digest and safe non-symlink paths must validate; the immutable output must be absent; and the plan must return ready=true with exit code 0.
accepted_source_snapshot.missing_or_invalid_source_semantics: Return a deterministic blocker and read zero candidate, comparator, daily-price or return values. Do not request or retry the provider.

candidate_construction.formula: For each exact-CB active at both endpoints with finite positive amount and finite cb_over_rate at both endpoints, compute cb_over_rate(t_minus_3)-cb_over_rate(t); take the arithmetic issuer median on t.
candidate_construction.daily_denominator: Factor-universe equities mapped to at least one exact-CB active on t, independent of daily endpoint availability.
candidate_construction.missing_semantics: Missing; never zero, filled or carried forward.
candidate_construction.information_clock: The value labelled t is first usable at the next accepted A-share session open.
forbidden_fields: bond OHLC, returns, pct_chg or price levels
equity price, return, volume, amount, valuation or fundamentals
any comparator before the coverage gate passes

coverage_first_gate.cross_sectional_distinctness: At least two exact finite float64 values without tolerance, rounding or binning.
coverage_first_gate.failure_semantics: Publish one immutable aggregate-only terminal result with comparator_values_read=false and numeric_comparator_count_read=0.

ordered_numeric_uniqueness.order_construction: Use Campaign263's exact 142 comparison definitions, then append Campaign263/higher exactly once.
source_sequence: comparators 1-140: frozen Campaign132 directional numeric design partitions, one comparator column at a time
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.pairwise_alignment: Exact instrument-session intersection only; no fill, imputation, substitution, winsorization or candidate-specific recomputation.
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.daily_statistic: Pearson correlation of average-tie percentile ranks, equivalent to average-tie Spearman rank correlation.
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.early_stop_semantics: Read exactly one comparator at a time in frozen order. The first insufficient-overlap or strict-correlation failure terminalizes Campaign265; no later comparator value may be read.
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.pass_semantics: Only all 143 ordered passes permit a later separately frozen single 2019-2023 development trial.

output_contract.publication: same-filesystem temporary write, fsync and exclusive hard-link publication; overwrite and rescue are forbidden
output_contract.result_content: Source verification receipts, aggregate coverage metrics and only the ordered comparator aggregate results actually read; no row-level candidate/comparator values.
